:::{#exr-standard-basis-expansion-practice}
#### Writing a vector as a linear combination of indicator vectors

By @thm-standard-basis-expansion,
every vector in $\reals^3$ is a [linear combination](#def-linear-combination)
of the [indicator vectors](#def-indicator-vector) $\vecf{e}_1$, $\vecf{e}_2$ and $\vecf{e}_3$.
Let

$$
\vx = \sbmat{-3 \\ 0 \\ 6}.
$$

Find the numbers $c_1$, $c_2$ and $c_3$
with $\vx = c_1 \vecf{e}_1 + c_2 \vecf{e}_2 + c_3 \vecf{e}_3$.

::: {.callout-tip}
#### Hint

Use @thm-standard-basis-expansion,
as in @exm-standard-basis-expansion.

:::
